stories.h: Snohomish County certifies election; tax supermajority charter amendment passes
stories.s: Certified results put turnout at 60.7%. Voters approved Prop. 5, which requires four of five council votes to raise taxes, along with financial-transparency and emergency-reserve charter amendments.

stories.h: Food-court fight, not gunfire, sparks Black Friday panic at Alderwood
stories.s: Shoppers fled Alderwood Mall Friday evening after a fight knocked over tables and chairs. Lynnwood police found no shooting and no injuries. Separately, a pedestrian was killed on Highway 99, closing the northbound lanes.

coming.h: County Council hearing on wetlands and habitat rules
coming.s: Public hearing on Ordinance 26-076, which revises critical-areas rules after a state growth board remand. 10:30 a.m. Wednesday at the Drewel Building in Everett, and on Zoom.

coming.h: Holiday Spark opens at Evergreen State Fair Park
coming.s: Free holiday festival in Monroe Dec. 3–6, running 5–8 p.m. on Thursday and Friday. Some activities cost extra, and parking is $5.

coming.h: Merrysville for the Holidays parade and tree lighting
coming.s: Holiday market, live reindeer and Santa photos start at 4 p.m. in Comeford Park. The Electric Lights Parade on State Avenue is at 6:30 p.m., and the tree lighting at 7:15.
